_doc: Chunking, exact (stdlib). A 1000-token doc with the answer span at [380,470] (binary answer-containment: recall@3 ∈ {0,1} = does ANY window fully contain the span?). size=200/overlap=0 → ceil(1000/200)=5 chunks; the answer STRADDLES boundary 400 (20 tok in chunk 2, 70 in chunk 3) → no chunk holds it whole → recall@3 = 0. overlap=50 → ceil(950/150)=7 chunks; window [300,500] holds [380,470] whole → recall@3 = 1.0. Overlap costs storage, buys recall. Frontier (essay): Late Chunking (arXiv:2409.04701) fixes the context-loss this exposes.
